description: Store one JPEG, PNG, MP4, or QuickTime creative from strict base64 content in the token-bound workspace.

content_base64.description: Strict standard base64 creative content, decoded to at most 5 MiB.

mime_type.description: Optional caller label accepted only for compatibility and ignored; creative type is derived from the bytes.

tags.description: Optional flat map of up to 32 string tags.

name: launch.creatives.store
title: Store Creative
